findings.text: the gate log's first line names rev 4b14dc941757c4752c560652a2b4b0d2eacdb4173, but the tree it tested carried the uncommitted change that became the delivered head bc028cb45; 4b14dc941's own content does not contain reckon/git_head.py and would fail this test, so a later reader who re-runs at the revision the log names gets a different result. The same mis-naming is in base-gate.log, head-suite.log, base-suite.log and negative-control.log in the same run directory.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified production call sites that reach the change
item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 934cacaaf0c1a325beeb1ff242a852b82b68ddb8: 4b14dc941 moved the import inside the function and did not fix the load, and bc028cb45 moved the four HEAD readers to reckon/git_head.py, re-exported them from git_dates.py, and repointed checkout_trust, plus the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_obligations_hook_reads_the_snapshot.py::test_the_prompt_path_loads_no_derivation_module passing at the change and failing at the base with paired logs; the source manifest records both arms plus a negative control, and the gate asserts exactly that measure.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to stop importing checkout_trust from loading a derivation module on the coordinator prompt hook's path; reckon/checkout_trust.py:45 imports _head_identity from the new stdlib-only reckon/git_head.py, and the original move-the-import-into-the-function mechanism was superseded by the coordinator's resume advice because a function-level import still imports git_dates and still reaches reckon._plan_html.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the source manifest; status complete, commits bc028cb45, and it records head-gate EXIT=0, base-gate EXIT=1, negative-control EXIT=1, and suites of 91 passed on both arms.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source node's declared paths were reckon/checkout_trust.py and the docs evidence fragment; the manifest and the diff also touch reckon/git_dates.py and a new reckon/git_head.py, both of which the coordinator granted in resume-1-advice.txt, so no write falls outside the granted scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_obligations_hook_reads_the_snapshot.py:296 asserts the loaded-module set contains no derivation module and reddens at the base and again under the negative control that restores the git_dates import.
justifications.evidence: the gate arms are recorded in the source run's logs (head-gate.log EXIT=0, base-gate.log EXIT=1, negative-control.log EXIT=1) but their header line names rev 4b14dc941 rather than the delivered head bc028cb45.
justifications.fit: reckon/git_head.py:1 documents the capability rather than any plan item and introduces no plan or ticket label; git_dates.py:12 re-exports with a noqa explaining the preserved import surface.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/checkout_trust.py:45 now imports _head_identity from the stdlib-only reckon/git_head.py, so importing checkout_trust loads no derivation module, which is the goal's stated outcome.
justifications.reuse: the four definitions are moved out of their existing owner reckon/git_dates.py into a lighter module, not re-implemented; git_dates.py:12 re-exports them, but the parallel spawn-free reader in reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:210 is a pre-existing duplicate this diff neither adds nor touches.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path (reckon/checkout_trust.py, reckon/git_dates.py, new reckon/git_head.py, the evidence fragment) is inside the scope granted by the coordinator's resume advice in resume-1-advice.txt plus the declared write paths.
